sections.title: মূল বিষয়বস্তু
sections.content_text: Section 2 Clause 1 - Depreciated Value “Depreciated Value ” means depreciated value as defined in Part 1 of the Third Schedule; Click here to see Bangla version Note: This is unofficial English translation. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail. Moreover, as per Section 345(2) of the Income Tax Act 2023, if there is a conflict between the English and Bengali text, the Bengali text shall prevail.
